title: Sungrow reports EnerNeo SST certification at OCP
specific_claims: Company reports system and component certificates.
Company attributes the certification to TÜV Rheinland.
supports: Verified existence and date of an attributable company announcement.
does_not_support: Independent certificate authenticity or complete scope validation.
A newly named operating customer data center, repeat procurement, or long-term field reliability.
conflicts_counter_evidence: No matching certificate ID or issuer record located within two targeted TÜV/Certipedia search queries. This does not establish absence of a certificate.
Company publicity is not independent issuer verification.
verification_scope: The company statement was read; its underlying certification claims remain attributed and unaccepted.
search_boundary: Official Sungrow article 1749 read; article 1748 inaccessible. Two issuer/registry-domain queries yielded generic SST service material, not a matching certificate. No authenticated certificate or named customer operation was reviewed.
next_minimum_verification: Find certificate identifiers and match models/scope/validity with the issuer; separately obtain attributable customer operating records. Any subsystem or accepted-state transition requires human review.
